title: ANVIL Policy as Code Schema
description: Declarative policy specification for ANVIL CI quality gates, security thresholds, and sandbox limits.

maxCritical.description: Maximum allowed critical security findings before gate failure.

maxHigh.description: Maximum allowed high-severity security findings before gate failure.

maxMedium.description: Maximum allowed medium-severity security findings before gate failure.

failOnSecrets.description: Immediately fail gate if any hardcoded secret is detected.

maxReviewHigh.description: Maximum allowed high-risk code review findings (e.g., eval or unvetted sinks).

requireCleanGit.description: Require a clean working tree without uncommitted changes.

allowInlineSuppressions.description: Whether inline suppression comments (anvil-disable-line, etc.) are permitted.

requireSuppressionReason.description: Require inline suppression comments to provide an explicit justification reason (e.g., '// anvil-disable-line RULE -- justification').

required.description: Require container sandbox execution for agent steps.

disallowedTools.description: CLI utilities or binaries prohibited from package.json scripts and shell execution patterns (e.g. ['curl', 'wget', 'nc', 'rm']). Matched against executable command names and script invocations using exact command word boundaries.

profile.description: Container security profile for dynamic verification runs (balanced, hardened, rootless-required). Advisory during static gate evaluation.

requireRootless.description: Require rootless Docker daemon for container verification runs. Advisory during static gate evaluation.

maxMemory.description: Maximum memory ceiling for containerized verification runs (e.g. '512m'). Advisory during static gate evaluation.

maxCpus.description: Maximum CPU quota for containerized verification runs. Advisory during static gate evaluation.

maxProcesses.description: Maximum process limit for containerized verification runs. Advisory during static gate evaluation.
